# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the
world.
* [Liza Destiny FPSO with sunset in background]
  
  ### Upstream
  
  Focused on strengthening energy security by expanding low-cost-of-supply, high-return oil and
  natural gas operations.
  
  [Learn more about our Upstream business][124]
* [Female engineer working in Baytown Technology and Engineering Complex]
  
  ### Product Solutions
  
  Integrating our downstream and chemical operations to develop lower-emission fuels and innovative
  products critical to modern society.
  
  [Learn more about our Downstream business][125]
  [Learn more about our Chemical business][126]
* [Scientist working in a lab]
  
  ### Low Carbon Solutions
  
  Helping reduce emissions by providing solutions to our industrial and commercial customers in
  growing markets for carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and biofuels.
  
  [Learn more about our Low Carbon Solutions business][127]

## Our global brands

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated
fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world. We’ve evolved our operating model and global
organization to better leverage the scale of our increasingly integrated company and global brands.

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the
world.
* [Liza Destiny FPSO with sunset in background]
  
  ### Upstream
  
  Focused on strengthening energy security by expanding low-cost-of-supply, high-return oil and
  natural gas operations.
  
  [Learn more about our Upstream business][124]
* [Female engineer working in Baytown Technology and Engineering Complex]
  
  ### Product Solutions
  
  Integrating our downstream and chemical operations to develop lower-emission fuels and innovative
  products critical to modern society.
  
  [Learn more about our Downstream business][125]
  [Learn more about our Chemical business][126]
* [Scientist working in a lab]
  
  ### Low Carbon Solutions
  
  Helping reduce emissions by providing solutions to our industrial and commercial customers in
  growing markets for carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and biofuels.
  
  [Learn more about our Low Carbon Solutions business][127]

## Our global brands

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated
fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world. We’ve evolved our operating model and global
organization to better leverage the scale of our increasingly integrated company and global brands.

# Creating a world of opportunities

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Growing from a small business in the Midwest to one of the largest privately held companies in the
world, Koch’s story is one of transformation: guided by principles, built for the long term and
focused on creating opportunities that help improve lives.  

[Get to know Koch][100]

What we do

## Everyday essentials. Transformative innovations.

Koch acquires, creates, develops and invests in a diverse group of companies, spanning from paper
goods to software and much more in between.

[See what our companies make][101]

Latest Happenings

Join us

## Put your potential to work

Find a role that matches your strengths at a company that helps you grow. With opportunities across
industries, Koch supports careers as unique as the people building them. 

[Discover opportunities][106]
[a woman wearing gloves and standing in a factory]

how we’re different

## Principled thinking. Real results.

Principle Based Management™ and stewardship guide everything we do — from how we empower employees
to how we innovate, solve problems and contribute to society.

## Innovation. Ingenuity.
## Unmatched Execution.

[Home Page_Hero_1230x575-6]

We care about the environment, our employees and the communities where we work and live. We work
every day to exhibit safe, stable and reliable operations, while delivering long-term value to our
shareholders.

We are focused on making products used in everyday life and being the safest and most reliable
operator in our industry, with environmentally responsible refining and renewable fuel operations.  

[Learn About Our Refining][50]
[Learn About Our Renewables][51]

Energy Industry Employer of Choice

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

#### About Us

## Learn More About Our Vision and Values

[Visit Adwa Connect][15]

### Supplying Global Markets. Empowering Business Growth

Adwa Solutions LLC is a global trade and business consulting company with head offices in the United
States and Cameroon. We provide reliable products and commodities to clients worldwide, managing
trade execution, quality control, and delivery through established international supply networks.

In addition to global trade, we offer hands-on business consulting services to help entrepreneurs
and companies start, structure, and scale their operations. By combining dependable supply solutions
with execution-focused strategy, Adwa Solutions LLC delivers both operational reliability and
strategic guidance—helping businesses grow confidently across international markets.

[Everyday Life - A to Z]

# A to Z

How our products find their way into your life.

 

 

 

[ Learn more about our products ][228]
[abstract image depicting fast movement]

## Generating a Cleaner Future

The energy and environmental challenges facing the planet need innovation and real investment now.
We believe hydrogen plays a key role in building a cleaner, more sustainable future. Hydrogen is an
ideal solution to address emissions from sectors requiring a high-density energy source, such as
heavy-duty transportation and industry, where electrification is not feasible or practical. As the
world’s largest hydrogen supplier, Air Products has taken major steps to accelerate the energy
transition. 

Today, there are buses, trucks and other heavy-duty vehicles around the world fueled with hydrogen
produced, distributed and supplied by Air Products. Our journey is well underway. We have the
technology, the track record, the capital and the ambition as a first-mover to bring the hydrogen
economy to scale.
[ Learn More ][229]

## HYDROGEN MEGAPROJECTS SUPPORTING ENERGY TRANSITION

[Louisiana landscape]

### [ Air Products Will Not Proceed with Louisiana Clean Energy (LCEC) Project ][230]

June 30, 2026 update: Air Products announced it will not proceed with the Louisiana Clean Energy
Complex (LCEC) project.

[Alberta Canada landscape of trees on mountains]

### [ Canada Net-zero Hydrogen Energy Complex   ][231]

Air Products’ net-zero hydrogen energy complex will produce clean hydrogen in Edmonton, Alberta,
Canada.

[Aerial view of NEOM Green Hydrogen Project, including marine jetty, in Saudi Arabia]

### [ NEOM Green Hydrogen Complex ][232]

Renewable energy facility in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia will be the world’s largest
green-hydrogen-based ammonia production facility.

## featured topics

[Onsite gas production plant within a fenced in enclosure]

### [ On-site Generated Gas ][233]

Flexible, fully-integrated, compact systems delivering uninterrupted, low cost, efficient gas supply

[CO2 Truck]

### [ Bulk Delivery and Storage Solutions ][234]

Worry-free bulk gas supply and delivery systems designed to meet your needs

[Cross section of Prism Membrane separator]

### [ Membranes ][235]

Pioneer in gas membrane separation for commercial use with early projects commissioned in 1977 and
full-scale commercialization in 1979.

[jazan]

### [ World-class Innovation ][236]

Air Products pioneered the “on-site” concept of producing and selling industrial gases in 1940. That
revolutionary idea not only launched our company, it launched the industrial gas industry we know
today.

[Heavy industry, steelmaking]

### [ Industrial Decarbonization ][237]

Learn how you can utilize hydrogen, and carbon capture and sequestration to decarbonize your
operations.

[Air Products joint venture with Lu'An]

### [ Syngas Solutions ][238]

Gasification converts fossil or biomass based hydrocarbons into syngas for making various downstream
derivatives.

## Looking for gas? Here's a quick way to find it.

When it comes to gases, we cover everything from argon to xenon and everything in between.  Find
what you need here or browse our industry or applications lists to find our full range of gases,
equipment, and services.

Ar

### [Argon][239]

Unique inerting properties to improve quality, optimize performance, and reduce costs.

CO₂

### [Carbon Dioxide][240]

Benefit from carbon dioxide's inert properties, as well as its cooling and freezing abilities.

CO

### [Carbon Monoxide][241]

Used in the production of chemicals ranging from acetic acid to polycarbonates to polyurethane
intermediates.

He

### [ Helium][242]

As a gas for lifting, leak detection, shielding, its inert properties and as a liquid for cooling.

H₂

### [Hydrogen ][243]

Valued for its reactive and protective properties to improve quality, optimize performance and
reduce costs.

N₂

[Everyday Life - A to Z]

# A to Z

How our products find their way into your life.

 

 

 

[ Learn more about our products ][228]
[abstract image depicting fast movement]

## Generating a Cleaner Future

The energy and environmental challenges facing the planet need innovation and real investment now.
We believe hydrogen plays a key role in building a cleaner, more sustainable future. Hydrogen is an
ideal solution to address emissions from sectors requiring a high-density energy source, such as
heavy-duty transportation and industry, where electrification is not feasible or practical. As the
world’s largest hydrogen supplier, Air Products has taken major steps to accelerate the energy
transition. 

Today, there are buses, trucks and other heavy-duty vehicles around the world fueled with hydrogen
produced, distributed and supplied by Air Products. Our journey is well underway. We have the
technology, the track record, the capital and the ambition as a first-mover to bring the hydrogen
economy to scale.
[ Learn More ][229]

## HYDROGEN MEGAPROJECTS SUPPORTING ENERGY TRANSITION

[Louisiana landscape]

### [ Air Products Will Not Proceed with Louisiana Clean Energy (LCEC) Project ][230]

June 30, 2026 update: Air Products announced it will not proceed with the Louisiana Clean Energy
Complex (LCEC) project.

[Alberta Canada landscape of trees on mountains]

### [ Canada Net-zero Hydrogen Energy Complex   ][231]

Air Products’ net-zero hydrogen energy complex will produce clean hydrogen in Edmonton, Alberta,
Canada.

[Aerial view of NEOM Green Hydrogen Project, including marine jetty, in Saudi Arabia]

### [ NEOM Green Hydrogen Complex ][232]

Renewable energy facility in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia will be the world’s largest
green-hydrogen-based ammonia production facility.

## featured topics

[Onsite gas production plant within a fenced in enclosure]

### [ On-site Generated Gas ][233]

Flexible, fully-integrated, compact systems delivering uninterrupted, low cost, efficient gas supply

[CO2 Truck]

### [ Bulk Delivery and Storage Solutions ][234]

Worry-free bulk gas supply and delivery systems designed to meet your needs

[Cross section of Prism Membrane separator]

### [ Membranes ][235]

Pioneer in gas membrane separation for commercial use with early projects commissioned in 1977 and
full-scale commercialization in 1979.

[jazan]

### [ World-class Innovation ][236]

Air Products pioneered the “on-site” concept of producing and selling industrial gases in 1940. That
revolutionary idea not only launched our company, it launched the industrial gas industry we know
today.

[Heavy industry, steelmaking]

### [ Industrial Decarbonization ][237]

Learn how you can utilize hydrogen, and carbon capture and sequestration to decarbonize your
operations.

[Air Products joint venture with Lu'An]

### [ Syngas Solutions ][238]

Gasification converts fossil or biomass based hydrocarbons into syngas for making various downstream
derivatives.

## Looking for gas? Here's a quick way to find it.

When it comes to gases, we cover everything from argon to xenon and everything in between.  Find
what you need here or browse our industry or applications lists to find our full range of gases,
equipment, and services.

Ar

### [Argon][239]

Unique inerting properties to improve quality, optimize performance, and reduce costs.

CO₂

### [Carbon Dioxide][240]

Benefit from carbon dioxide's inert properties, as well as its cooling and freezing abilities.

CO

### [Carbon Monoxide][241]

Used in the production of chemicals ranging from acetic acid to polycarbonates to polyurethane
intermediates.

He

### [ Helium][242]

As a gas for lifting, leak detection, shielding, its inert properties and as a liquid for cooling.

H₂

### [Hydrogen ][243]

Valued for its reactive and protective properties to improve quality, optimize performance and
reduce costs.

N₂

Widely used as a gas for its inert properties and a liquid for cooling and freezing.

# Remembering is easier with Anki

Anki is a flashcard program that helps you spend more time on challenging material, and less on what
you already know.

[Download Anki ][9]

## advantages

Here are a few reasons why users love Anki.

### Synchronization

The free AnkiWeb synchronization service lets you sync your cards across devices.

### Media Support

Audio, images, videos, and scientific markup can be used in your flashcards.

### Customization

Easily change your flashcard layouts and the timing of their reviews.

### Optimization

Anki can handle decks of 100,000+ cards with no problems.

### Add-ons

Install add-ons to extend Anki with new features and functionality.

## testimonials

See what people are saying about Anki.

[Michael A. Nielsen, "Augmenting Long-term Memory"][10]
The single biggest change that Anki brings about is that it means memory is no longer a haphazard
event, to be left to chance. Rather, it guarantees I will remember something, with minimal effort.
That is, Anki makes memory a choice.

## basic concepts

Anki supports complex workflows, but getting started is easy.

[deck-graphic-light] [deck-graphic-dark]

### Decks

Decks are groups of flashcards that allow you to study specific parts of your collection instead of
everything all at once. Create a new deck and add some flashcards to get started.

[review-graphic-light] [review-graphic-dark]

### Reviews

When you're ready, start reviewing your flashcards. Rate your recall with the most suitable option
and Anki will schedule the next review for when you're most likely to forget the information.

## contributing

Anki is a community project where anyone can make contributions to help improve everyone's
experience.

[

### open source   [outlink]

If you know how to code you could help maintain Anki or create new add-ons/features.

][11][

### share decks   [outlink]

Sharing your deck can make it easier for others to start learning what you're studying.

][12][

### translate anki   [outlink]

Help with the efforts to translate Anki so it can become more accessible to everyone.

][13]

## downloads

Choose the correct download for your platform. For details, see the [installation guide][14].

### Desktop

Current version is 26.05
The free computer version is available for all major platforms.

#### Windows

[ Windows 10+ (x64)][15] [ Windows 11 (ARM)][16]

#### macOS

[ macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon)][17] [ macOS 13+ (Intel)][18]

#### Linux

[ Linux (x64) 2022+][19] [ Linux (ARM) 2024+][20]
[Installation Guide ][21] [Change Notes & Older Releases ][22]

### Mobile

AnkiMobile is the official iOS app and all purchases help fund Anki's development.

AnkiDroid for Android is free and developed by contributors. All [donations][23] help fund
AnkiDroid's development.

#### iOS

[ AnkiMobile][24]

#### Android

[ AnkiDroid][25]
Anki is a registered trademark of Ankitects Pty Ltd.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

## What types of companies do you work with?

We work with a wide range of clients including fuel distributors, oil traders, refineries, marine
bunker suppliers, industrial manufacturers, power generation companies, and international commodity
traders.

## Do you offer fuel storage facilities?

Yes. We coordinate secure bulk fuel storage solutions for petroleum products such as diesel,
gasoline, marine fuel, and aviation fuel through managed terminal and storage networks.

## How can I request a quote or partnership?

You can contact our team directly through the website contact form or email us with your
requirements. Our representatives will respond with tailored solutions based on your operational
needs.

## Can you handle large-scale fuel logistics operations?

Yes. Our logistics network and coordinated partnerships allow us to manage large-volume fuel
transportation and storage operations efficiently and reliably.

## Do you provide international logistics services?

Yes. We support cross-border and international energy logistics through coordinated shipping,
documentation support, terminal handling, and supply chain management services.

## How do you ensure safety in your operations?

Safety is a core priority. We follow strict operational procedures, industry standards, and risk
management practices across all storage, transportation, and terminal activities.

## What services does Da Yang Energy Storage & Logistics provide?

We provide integrated energy logistics solutions including fuel storage, petroleum transportation,
energy warehousing, terminal operations support, supply chain coordination, and international
trading logistics assistance.

### ELI Roberts & Sons, based in Tallahassee Florida, is a major petroleum distributor and diesel
### fuel supplier and has been in the gas and oil business since 1958.


Over the years, we have become one of the major petroleum distributors servicing the Florida
Panhandle and surrounding areas. We are proud suppliers of Sunoco, Marathon, and Pure brand fuels.
We provide fuel and lubricant solutions to various commercial, agricultural, industrial, municipal,
and retail business sectors.

As a 3-generation family business with over 60 years of service to our community, Eli Roberts & Sons
is dedicated to providing the highest quality products and services available. If you require fleet
fueling services, we are the company to do business with. We have multiple fleet fueling facilities
that are conveniently located with 24/7 access. We also specialize in emergency services and
generator fueling for large and small businesses, medical facilities, and hospitals.

Give Eli Roberts & Sons a chance to earn your business and “we guarantee” you’ll be glad you did.

### Unique & Diversified

We serve customers throughout the Southeast United States and can give turn-key service 365/7/24. As
a petroleum distributor we have major fuel partners and are proud to carry “Sunoco, Marathon and
Pure brand fuels”.  Whether Diesel Fuel, Standard Gas, No Ethanol Marine Gas, Racing Fuel,
Lubricants or DEF, ELI Roberts & Sons is there to serve.

### 3 Generation Family Owned Business

Since 1958 we have been a family owned and operated company. Mr. Eli Senior started with a gas
station on Tennessee Street in Tallahassee, FL and served the community for many years. Son and
Grandson are now part of the team taking ELI Roberts & Sons into the future on a stable foundation.

### 365/7/24

Dedicated to the long haul, we are there 365 days a year, 7 days a week, 24 hours a day. We are
dedicated to providing fuel services to your business. Emergency storm services are a specialty of
ours. With tanker pumping stations and a team of dedicated specialists we are ready for refueling
emergency vehicles for first responders.

### Integrity & Service

Our expert staff is customer service oriented with a focus on customer’s needs. We have a 60 year
history of very satisfied customers and have formed some great relationships during this time. Give
us a chance to be your fuel supplier and you will be glad you did.

### Emergency Generator Fueling & Emergency Vehicle Fueling

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][68]

Enterprise Solution


Esco Aster’s Enterprise Solutions offer a vertically integrated, one-stop framework for the
specialized design, construction, and validation of world-class life science and healthcare
facilities

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][69]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# welcome to the Filling station museum

[Start Virtual Tour][4]

## Step Back in Time

Step into a bygone era at The Filling Station Museum, nestled in the historic heart of Quincy,
Florida. Experience the charm of vintage Americana as you explore our private collection, curated by
Wilson Hinson of the Hinson Oil family.

[Gas Pump Globes on display at The Filling Station Museum Quincy Florida]

## Explore Our Collection:
* Petrol Signs: Marvel at dozens of full-size vintage signs that once adorned gas stations across
  America.
* Antique Gas Pumps & Globes: Admire the craftsmanship of yesteryears with our array of beautifully
  preserved gas pumps and their iconic globes.
* Photographs & Memorabilia: Dive into history with photographs and artifacts that tell the story of
  automotive evolution.

Start your tour by scanning a Tour Stop QR plaque located throughout the musuem or press the button
below to view online.

[Start Tour][5]
[Outside View Window at Filling Station Museum Quincy FL. Vintage Gas Pumps, Signs and Memorabilia]

## Stop In

#### Where

Historic Downtown Quincy Florida

19 North Madison Street
Quincy, FL 32351

#### When

The Museum is generally open between:

Tuesday – Saturday
7:00 am -3:00 pm

[Virtual Tour Open 24 Hours][6]


### "A Fascinating Journey Through Time" - Sarah J."

 “The Filling Station Museum in Quincy, Florida, offers a captivating look into the past with its
impressive collection of vintage gas station memorabilia. From the massive porcelain signs to the
antique gas pumps, each piece tells a story of American road travel history. The self-guided QR tour
adds an interactive element that truly enhances the experience. A must-visit for anyone interested
in petroliana or the golden age of automobiles!”

### "Nostalgia at Its Finest" - Mike D.

“I was blown away by the authenticity and detail at the Filling Station Museum. The Sinclair, Gulf,
and Texaco signs are in remarkable condition, and the way they’ve integrated the museum with a
dining experience is genius. You get to eat surrounded by history! The virtual tour option on their
website is a nice touch for those who can’t visit in person. Highly recommend for any car lover or
history buff.”

### "Educational and Entertaining" - Lisa M.

“Visiting the Filling Station Museum was both educational and entertaining for my students. The
museum’s collection, including the impressive 6-foot Sinclair sign, provided a tangible connection
to the history of the oil industry and American culture. The QR codes for each exhibit were a hit,
making learning interactive and fun. It’s a unique blend of history, memorabilia, and a community
dining space that I’d visit again.”

### Standards

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

## Mentoring Program

**The mentoring program will focus on two mentees and be 24 months in length. Mentees are expected
to commit 16 hours per month to the program. The mentees will be paired with mentors from the
Hydrogen Safety Panel based on the mentee's current levels of technical expertise and desired
technical areas for learning.**

Mentoring will take place primarily by electronic means (e.g., teleconferences, email, chats,
eLearning platform), supplemented by in-person meetings as program resources permit. At the
conclusion of the program, mentees will have completed a series of hydrogen safety training
courses with the support of our partners and demonstrated the necessary knowledge, skills, and
ability to independently contribute to safety review activities typically performed by the HSP. At
the end of the program, the mentees may be offered an opportunity to join the HSP.

## Hydrogen Safety Panel
## Mentoring Program

**The mentoring program will focus on two mentees and be 24 months in length. Mentees are expected
to commit 16 hours per month to the program. The mentees will be paired with mentors from the
Hydrogen Safety Panel based on the mentee's current levels of technical expertise and desired
technical areas for learning.**

Mentoring will take place primarily by electronic means (e.g., teleconferences, email, chats,
eLearning platform), supplemented by in-person meetings as program resources permit. At the
conclusion of the program, mentees will have completed a series of hydrogen safety training
courses with the support of our partners and demonstrated the necessary knowledge, skills, and
ability to independently contribute to safety review activities typically performed by the HSP. At
the end of the program, the mentees may be offered an opportunity to join the HSP.

Sobre Nosotros

## Kaizen Energy es una empresa líder en la provisión de servicios integrales de alto valor
## agregado.

Especializada en dar soporte crítico a la industria petrolera, gasífera y eléctrica, así como a los
sectores de construcción e infraestructura. Nuestra ventaja competitiva reside en la gestión
eficiente de proyectos complejos, abarcando desde la consultoría técnica especializada, la
ingeniería, la ejecución operacional, los servicios logísticos y el soporte en automatización,
tecnología y sistemas de control.

Operamos bajo un estricto marco de calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo, garantizando la
máxima eficiencia y la optimización de recursos en cada proyecto. El nombre Kaizen (mejora continua)
define nuestra filosofía: evolucionar constantemente para superar las expectativas del cliente y
adaptarnos a los desafíos más exigentes del mercado global.

[Misión]

### Misión

Proveer soluciones integrales y sostenibles de ingeniería, construcción y consultoría técnica
especializada para los sectores de petróleo, gas, electricidad, tecnología, automatización, sistemas
y servicios logísticos. Nuestro compromiso es garantizar la excelencia operativa y la eficiencia en
la ejecución de proyectos, mediante el uso de tecnología de vanguardia y un equipo de profesionales
altamente cualificados. Nos dedicamos a generar valor estratégico para nuestros clientes, actuando
con la máxima responsabilidad, ética y un inquebrantable foco en la calidad y la seguridad.

[Visión]

### Visión

Ser reconocida globalmente como la empresa referente y socio estratégico de elección en la provisión
de servicios integrales para la industria energética e infraestructura, destacando por nuestra
capacidad de innovación, el liderazgo técnico y la ejecución eficiente de proyectos y servicios.
Buscamos establecer estándares de calidad y eficiencia superiores, impulsando la mejora continua
(Kaizen) en todos nuestros procesos para contribuir al desarrollo sostenible y la optimización
productiva de nuestros clientes.

## Nuestros Servicios

Soluciones integrales diseñadas para la industria energética e infraestructura.

[Reparación equipos lacustres]

### Reparación equipos lacustres

Brindamos mantenimiento especializado y reparación integral de embarcaciones y equipos utilizados en
ambientes lacustres, fluviales y costeros.

[Servicios especializados a pozos]

### Servicios especializados a pozos

Soluciones completas incluyendo servicios con guaya fina y gruesa, mantenimiento de cabezales y
pruebas especializadas.

[Construcción y mantenimiento]

### Construcción y mantenimiento

Construcción de atracaderos, plataformas industriales, tendido y reparación de líneas para el
desarrollo de infraestructuras.

[Transporte lacustre]

### Transporte lacustre

Soluciones logísticas integrales para el traslado seguro y eficiente de materiales, equipos y
personal en rutas terrestres y lacustres.

[Automatización (SCADA)]

### Automatización (SCADA)

Implementamos soluciones de automatización para optimizar la operación, el monitoreo y el control de
pozos petroleros y equipos industriales.

[Operaciones logísticas]

### Operaciones logísticas

Coordinamos y ejecutamos operaciones logísticas estratégicas para garantizar el suministro oportuno
de materiales, equipos y personal.

## Detalle de Servicios a Pozos

Contamos con experiencia especializada y equipos de última generación para intervenciones críticas
en pozos, garantizando operaciones seguras y eficientes.

ingeniería, la ejecución operacional, los servicios logísticos y el soporte en automatización,

Operamos bajo un estricto marco de calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo, garantizando la
máxima eficiencia y la optimización de recursos en cada proyecto. El nombre Kaizen (mejora continua)
define nuestra filosofía: evolucionar constantemente para superar las expectativas del cliente y
adaptarnos a los desafíos más exigentes del mercado global.

[Misión]

### Misión

Proveer soluciones integrales y sostenibles de ingeniería, construcción y consultoría técnica
especializada para los sectores de petróleo, gas, electricidad, tecnología, automatización, sistemas
y servicios logísticos. Nuestro compromiso es garantizar la excelencia operativa y la eficiencia en
la ejecución de proyectos, mediante el uso de tecnología de vanguardia y un equipo de profesionales
altamente cualificados. Nos dedicamos a generar valor estratégico para nuestros clientes, actuando
con la máxima responsabilidad, ética y un inquebrantable foco en la calidad y la seguridad.

[Visión]

Ser reconocida globalmente como la empresa referente y socio estratégico de elección en la provisión
de servicios integrales para la industria energética e infraestructura, destacando por nuestra
capacidad de innovación, el liderazgo técnico y la ejecución eficiente de proyectos y servicios.
Buscamos establecer estándares de calidad y eficiencia superiores, impulsando la mejora continua

## FROM THE CREATORS OF HALO AND DESTINY

Infil into the dark sci-fi world of Tau Ceti IV: A derelict colony rife with Runners, UESC security
forces, and unpredictable environments. As you scavenge for valuables with a crew or alone, tense
exploration breaks into fast-paced PvP combat.

 

Exfil to assemble stronger builds with your stolen loot. Then put your gear back on the line to seek
greater fortunes in your next run.

A GRAVEYARD OF POSSIBILITIES

## TAU CETI IV

Trespass across deserted research facilities, rugged landscapes, and security outposts holding the
remnants of a vanished expedition. Each zone escalates in difficulty, preparing you for the UESC
Marathon locked in the heavens.

[Watch on Youtube][17]
[Three UESC enemies Prepare to attack the player.]

### TAU CETI IV // SURFACE DATA

Tau Ceti IV remains a restricted zone. What's known about its surface comes from fragmented
transmissions, recovered field data, and incomplete zone surveys. Accuracy is not guaranteed.
Information is limited. Study what's here before you deploy.

Marathon Supply Chain contributes to the company’s sustainable development by striving to
continuously improve our performance as it relates to environmental stewardship, social
responsibility, and long-term economic growth while ensuring we comply with all domestic and
international laws.  Our commitment to sustainability is integrated into our strategic planning,

here][8] to download the Supplier Code of Conduct**. 

By operating in a sustainable way, Marathon and our Suppliers can ensure better working conditions
for individuals and promote long-term economic growth in the local economies and communities in
which we operate while minimizing the impact we have on the environment.

## Supplier Expectations Regarding Sustainability

#### Social Responsibility
* **Safety** – Marathon is committed to creating a safe work environment for our employees and
  Suppliers.  We continually focus on improving our safety management systems, compliance programs,
  and overall safety culture with a goal of having an accident-free, incident-free workplace.  We
  expect our Suppliers to align with our safety values, have robust safety programs, promote a
  strong safety culture, and not only adhere to, but also be an advocate of Marathon’s safety
  processes and culture while working on our behalf.
* **Human Rights** – Marathon respects the human, cultural and legal rights of all individuals and
  communities, and promotes the goals and principles of the United Nations Declaration of Human
  Rights.  These commitments extend to the fair treatment and meaningful involvement of all people,
  including indigenous people, regardless of race, color, sex, gender, national origin, or any other
  status protected by law.  We expect our Suppliers to align with our human rights values, comply
  with laws and regulations related to human rights, and promote positive practices that support
  human rights for all individuals.
* **Diversity and Inclusion** – Partnering with diverse Suppliers, including local suppliers and
  businesses owned and operated by people who are minorities, women, veterans, person with a
  disability and/or disadvantaged, attracts qualified suppliers, stimulates local economic
  development, drives innovation, and creates lasting social benefits in the communities in which we
  live and work. 
* **Ethics and Compliance with Laws** – Marathon complies with all domestic and international laws
  where we operate.  Our employees perform their daily work while upholding the highest standards of
  business ethics and integrity in a manner consistent with [Marathon’s Code of Business
  Conduct][9].  We expect our Suppliers to act with integrity, conduct business in an ethical
  manner, comply with all laws and regulations applicable to the delivery of goods and services
  being provided, and adhere the standards set forth in [Marathon’s Supplier Code of Conduct][10].
* **Environmental Stewardship** – Marathon is committed to minimizing our impact on the environment
  and complying with applicable environmental laws and regulations.  We strive to utilize energy and
  natural resources efficiently, continuously improve environmental performance, and reduce and
  prevent waste, emissions, and releases.  Marathon expects our Suppliers to align with our
  environmental stewardship values and strive to minimize the environmental impact of their
  operations.
* **Long-Term Economic Growth** – Marathon believes supporting and striving to improve key
  sustainability factors such as social responsibility and environmental stewardship will promote
  long-term economic growth in the economies and communities where we operate.  We expect our
  Suppliers to share our same sustainability values and strive to promote long-term economic growth
  in the communities in which they operate.

## Recognizing Outstanding Supplier Performance

Suppliers who positively impact our business are honored at our annual Supplier Recognition Awards
(SRA).  Suppliers are nominated by Marathon employees for awards across multiple categories that
align with our Core values.  The award categories and related nomination criteria are as follows:

**Partner in Excellence** – A supplier recognized with the Partner in Excellence Award strives for
exceptional performance. They embrace continuous improvement, innovation and never settling for the
status quo. They uphold rigorous expectations and have an ownership and accountability mindset.

**Partner in Collaboration** – A supplier recognized with the Partner in Collaboration Award
actively partners with Marathon to find and create shared value, making a positive difference
together. They foster a respectful and constructive partnership while creating peer leading
solutions.

**Partner in Inclusion** – A supplier recognized with the Partner in Inclusion Award embodies
diversity in culture, background, perspective and experience. They promote inclusion and contribute
to a work environment that maximizes full potential for business success.

**Supplier of the Year** - A supplier recognized with the Supplier of the Year Award embodies
multiple award categories and their extraordinary performance enables Marathon to be a peer leader
in the energy industry. Their willingness to pivot and support when new opportunities arise and
engage in collaborative efforts have resulted in a strong partnership with Marathon.

## Supplier Expectations

Marathon Supply Chain believes that building strong relationships with Suppliers is essential to
running our business.  Marathon seeks to work with Suppliers that have the following values,
qualities, and capabilities.
* Possess robust safety programs, have a strong safety culture, and are committed to not only
  adhering to, but also to being an advocate of Marathon’s safety processes and culture while
  working on our behalf
* Act with integrity, conduct business in an ethical manner, obey laws, and adhere to Marathon’s
  Supplier Code of Conduct
* Strive to improve key sustainability factors such as environmental stewardship and social
  responsibility which promote long-term economic growth in local economies and communities
* Encourage positive practices that support inclusion and promote human rights for all individuals
* Demonstrate strong financial health and viability
* Possess a strong understanding of Marathon’s business and value chain
* Provide value added capabilities, innovation, and a competitive advantage for Marathon
* Protect confidential information
* Comply with contractual obligations

## Diverse Suppliers

Partnering with diverse businesses, including local suppliers, attracts qualified goods and services
providers, stimulates local economic development, drives innovation, and creates lasting social
benefits in the communities in which we live and work. Marathon actively builds partnerships with
diverse suppliers across our operations, and we are committed to providing equal and impartial
opportunities to meet our business needs.

 

###### Diverse Business Defined

A diverse business is any company in which at least 51% of the ownership is of a designated diverse
background such as women, minorities, LGBTQ, veterans, person with a disability and/or
disadvantaged.  In addition, companies designated as small businesses as well as companies in
historically underutilized business zones (i.e., HUBZone business) also qualify as a diverse
business. Small Businesses must meet specific size standards based on industry, revenue, and
employee count.

 

###### Diverse Business Certification Requirements

In order for a company to qualify as a diverse business, the company must be certified as a
Disabled-owned Business (DOBE), LGBT-owned Business (LGBTBE), Minority-owned Business (MBE), Small
Business Enterprise (SBE), Veteran-owned Business (VBE), or Women-owned Business (WBE) by a
nationally or regionally recognized third party, including but not limited to the following
organizations or their regional affiliates:
* National Minority Supplier Development Council ([NMSDC][11])
* Women's Business Enterprise National Council ([WBENC][12])
* Disability:IN [https://disabilityin.org/][13]
* National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC) ([NVBDC][14])
* United States Small Business Administration ([SBA][15])
* National LGBT Chamber of Commerce ([NGLCC][16])
* U.S. Small Business Administration ([SBA][17])

We ensure seamless supply chain operations for your air logistics needs.

Our in-country teams work closely with your vendors to monitor goods availability, arrange

## Our logistics services

Our logistics service: Noatum Logistics is renowned for its excellent service and specialised staff
who have positioned the company as an industry leader offering solutions to meet the needs of our
clients in a variety of sectors.

### Air freight

We ensure seamless supply chain operations for your air logistics needs.

[Read more…][119]

#### [Ocean freight][120]

### Ocean freight

With our extensive global network of key ship carriers, we guarantee optimal space allocation and
competitive rates for your ocean cargo needs.

[Read more…][121]

#### [Inland transport][122]

### Inland transport

Our in-country teams work closely with your vendors to monitor goods availability, arrange
collection and delivery, and ensure smooth inland transportation, navigating roads daily to prevent
disruptions in your supply chain.

[Read more…][123]

#### [Customs brokerage][124]

### Customs brokerage

We improve operating efficiencies and cash flows by streamlining the entire lifecycle of global
trade.

[Read more…][125]

We provide value to the entire supply chain through the comprehensive management of logistics
specific to the market and with the integration of all processes, such as warehouse, transport, and
value-added services.

[Read more…][127]

### Value supply chain management

Our dedicated teams blend local knowledge and global expertise with leading-edge technology and
proven processes to create our competitive advantage.

[Read more…][129]

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

[ Learn about Owler Pro ][63]

Account Executive

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

## The complete document management solutions

From creation to signature to payment, PandaDoc is a 360-degree document management solution that
helps your teams get more done, faster.

[Request a demo][103]
Benefits
Create

Easily generate custom agreements tailored to your audience and workflow with our drag-and-drop
editor.

[Smart content][104]
Collaborate

With PandaDoc, everyone’s eyes are on the same document for real-time redlining, comments,
approvals, and more.

[Workspaces][105][Rooms][106]
Automate

PandaDoc's CRM integrations, embeddable API, and automation features speed up your workflows while
eliminating errors and repetitive tasks.

[CRM integration][107][API][108]
Sign

Not only can you capture signatures, but decide signing order, verify the identity of recipients,
set signing groups, and even notarize documents.

[Signing order][109][eSignature][110]
Analyze

PandaDoc records an audit trail for every document, reports user activity, and tracks document
metrics, too.

[Document tracking][111][Audit trail][112]
Get paid

Easily embed trusted payment gateways directly into bills and invoices so customers can pay with
just a few clicks.

[Payments][113]

## Safe, secure, and
## legally binding

PandaDoc is E-SIGN, UETA, HIPAA compliant, and SOC 2 certified, offering secure electronic
signatures. It also provides SSO and a robust API for granular document and workspace permissions.

## The complete document management solutions

From creation to signature to payment, PandaDoc is a 360-degree document management solution that
helps your teams get more done, faster.

[Request a demo][103]
Benefits
Create

Easily generate custom agreements tailored to your audience and workflow with our drag-and-drop
editor.

[Smart content][104]
Collaborate

With PandaDoc, everyone’s eyes are on the same document for real-time redlining, comments,
approvals, and more.

[Workspaces][105][Rooms][106]
Automate

PandaDoc's CRM integrations, embeddable API, and automation features speed up your workflows while
eliminating errors and repetitive tasks.

[CRM integration][107][API][108]
Sign

Not only can you capture signatures, but decide signing order, verify the identity of recipients,
set signing groups, and even notarize documents.

[Signing order][109][eSignature][110]
Analyze

PandaDoc records an audit trail for every document, reports user activity, and tracks document
metrics, too.

[Document tracking][111][Audit trail][112]
Get paid

Easily embed trusted payment gateways directly into bills and invoices so customers can pay with
just a few clicks.

[Payments][113]

## Safe, secure, and
## legally binding

PandaDoc is E-SIGN, UETA, HIPAA compliant, and SOC 2 certified, offering secure electronic
signatures. It also provides SSO and a robust API for granular document and workspace permissions.

The Saint Petersburg International Mercantile Exchange (SPIMEX) was established in May 2008 under
the decision of President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin and the Government of the Russian
Federation.
SPIMEX is the largest commodities exchange in Russia that hosts 99% of organized trading in crude
oil and refined products, natural gas, timber and mineral fertilizers in the country.

**Veru**** Oil Petroleum Trading Corporation** is a Canada‑registered energy company with a
strategic branch in Dubai. Through premier tank‑farms in Fujairah and Hamriyah and a truly global

## Vision

To be the most trusted link in global energy, effortlessly connecting Asia, the Middle East, Africa,
